sharing.address_explainer_own_body: Point a domain at your own server and enter it here. There is no middleman at all: people connect straight to that address. It is what invite links are built from, and what passkeys are bound to — a browser will only accept one for the domain it was made on. The domain needs to answer HTTPS, which a reverse proxy such as Cloudflare Tunnel, Caddy or nginx does for you. A bare IP address will not work: home addresses change, and browsers reject a certificate for one.
sharing.address_explainer_without_body: Everything still works: this server is reachable on your own network, and the StingStream app reaches it from anywhere. What you do not get is a link somebody can open in a browser away from home, or passkeys — those need a domain a browser can verify. An invite still works; it is a code rather than a link.
sharing.address_ok: Looks right. Your server will check it when you save.
sharing.address_problem_insecure: Needs to be https. A browser will not store a session over plain http.
sharing.address_problem_ip_address: An IP address will not work: it changes, and no certificate authority will issue for one. Use a domain.
sharing.address_problem_not_a_url: That is not an address. Try something like media.example.com.
sharing.address_problem_single_label: Nothing outside your own network can look that up. Use a full domain.
sharing.admin_only_reason: Only the server's owner can set up sharing.
sharing.create_detail: Send them the link this makes. When they open it on their own StingStream, your libraries appear on their server and theirs on yours — each of you choosing which.
sharing.create_live_detail: Your server is its first member. Send this link to whoever should join.

sharing.invite_copy_failed: Could not copy — select the code and copy it by hand.
sharing.invite_link_description: This link works once, for the first server that opens it. Send it only to the person you mean it for, and make another if you need a second.
sharing.invite_no_host_detail: This server has no domain of its own, so there is nowhere for an invite link to point. Add one under Sharing → Advanced, or share the invite code instead.
sharing.invite_no_host_title: No address to invite people to
sharing.join_camera_detail: Scanning an invite needs the camera. You can always type the code instead.
sharing.join_camera_hint: Point the camera at the invite QR on the other device.
sharing.join_clipboard_denied: The browser would not share the clipboard.
sharing.join_detail: Paste the invite link you were sent. The other server has to be online to let you in, and the link stops working once it has.

sharing.join_link_placeholder: Paste a link or an invite code
sharing.join_success_no_answer: Rejoined {{name}}, but nobody answered. It will sync when a member comes online.
sharing.join_tv_hint: There is no camera here, so the link has to be pasted. The invite inside it uses base58, which has no look-alike characters — no 0/O and no 1/l/I — and carries a checksum, so a damaged one is refused rather than half-joining.
sharing.link_libraries_hint: Only the libraries you tick. Change it whenever you like — un-ticking one takes it off their server.
sharing.member_removed_result: {{name}} removed. {{count}} members took the new secret; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.member_removed_result_one: {{name}} removed. {{count}} member took the new secret; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.member_removed_result_other: {{name}} removed. {{count}} members took the new secret; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.members_empty_hint: Send someone an invite link to add one.
sharing.members_hint: "Direct" means bytes travel peer to peer; "relayed" means they pass through a relay, which still works but costs someone bandwidth. A member with no path yet is simply one nothing has been asked of.
sharing.members_unavailable: This server could not be asked who is sharing: {{message}}
sharing.mesh_unavailable_detail: Sharing is unavailable until it comes back. Playback still works — your server proxies the stream instead.
sharing.mesh_unavailable_title: Sharing is not running on this server
sharing.own_field_blank: Empty: the app still reaches this server from anywhere, but there is no link to open in a browser away from home.
sharing.own_field_hint: A domain you have pointed at this server. Invite links are built from it, and it is what makes passkeys possible.
sharing.remove_member_warning: {{name}} loses access immediately, and the secret is rotated so they cannot get back in. Every invite handed out before now stops working, including any this screen has already shown. There is no undo: the only way back is a fresh invite.
sharing.removing_member: Removing {{name}} and rotating the secret. The new secret is handed to every member that is awake, one at a time, so this can take a few minutes. Leave this screen open.
sharing.rotate_secret_result: Secret rotated. {{count}} members took the new one; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.rotate_secret_result_one: Secret rotated. {{count}} member took the new one; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.rotate_secret_result_other: Secret rotated. {{count}} members took the new one; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.rotate_secret_warning: Every invite handed out before now stops working, including any this screen has already shown. Nobody is removed: every current member is handed the new secret, and the ones that are asleep take it the next time they connect.
sharing.rotating_secret: Rotating the secret. The new secret is handed to every member that is awake, one at a time, so this can take a few minutes. Leave this screen open.

invites.error_spent: This invite can no longer be used. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
invites.error_invalid: That name or password cannot be used.
invites.error_unreachable: The server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
invites.new_description: They open the link and choose a password. It works until you delete it.
invites.libraries_hint: Pick at least one. They will see these and nothing else.
invites.libraries_none: This server has no libraries yet.
invites.minted_link: Send this link to the person you are inviting.
invites.minted_no_link: This server has no address anybody could open, so there is no link. Send them this code — they can enter it in the StingStream app.
invites.lan_only_title: This link works on your home network
invites.lan_only_body: It points at this machine’s address on your network, so it will open for anyone in the house and nowhere else. Give your server a domain and the same invites work from anywhere.
invites.link_gone: That invite has already been used, so there is no link left to show.
invites.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.detail: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or security key instead of a password. Your password still works.
passkeys.empty_detail: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or security key instead of typing a password. It works on {{domain}}, and your password still works everywhere.
passkeys.row_other_domain: Made for {{domain}} — it will not work at this server's current address.
passkeys.error_unavailable: Passkeys are not available on this server.
passkeys.error_register: That passkey could not be added.
passkeys.error_remove: That passkey could not be removed.
passkeys.error_sign_in: That passkey could not be used to sign in.

users.title: Users
users.empty_detail: Invite someone and they get an account on this server, seeing only the libraries you pick.
users.reset_description: Set a new password for {{name}}. They are not told, so you will have to pass it on yourself.
users.reset_hint: They can change it themselves once they are signed in.
users.delete_confirm_detail: Their account, their sessions and their playlists go with them, and there is no undo. Disabling keeps the account and locks them out instead.
users.libraries_description: They see the libraries you tick here and nothing else. Ticking all of them means everything, including libraries you add later.
users.libraries_administrator: Administrators can see every library, whatever is ticked here.
